description: A small white block-built chair model sits on a dark blue bedspread in front of a pink pillow. The left hand rests on the base to steady the chair while the right hand reaches in from the right, pinches the top/back block section, lifts and wiggles it upward to loosen it, then pulls that piece away to the right so it becomes a right-hand object while the remaining chair stays in place as a left-hand object.
